name: Paclitaxel (weekly single-agent)
cyclesNote: weekly dosing, commonly 3 weeks on then 1 week off within a 28-day cycle; continue while controlled and tolerated. Physician determined.

institution.provenance: StewardMD draft Standard Protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

premedications.name: Corticosteroid + H1/H2 antihistamine
premedications.notes: standard taxane hypersensitivity premedication before each dose.

supportiveCare: Monitor for infusion/hypersensitivity reactions, especially early doses.
Assess peripheral neuropathy each visit; dose-reduce or hold for grade 2 or higher.
monitoring: Neuropathy assessment; response imaging every 2 to 3 cycles.

drugs.name: Paclitaxel
drugs.notes: Paclitaxel 80 mg/m2 IV over about 1 hour weekly (days 1, 8, 15 of a 28-day cycle, with a week off), given with standard taxane premedication. Sequential single-agent cytotoxic option for later-line advanced/recurrent endometrial carcinoma after progression through prior systemic therapy. Dose scaled by BSA (engine multiplies by body-surface area). Author's own wording; general reference NCCN / DeVita.
